# Quantum access first study

Informed first source study for #29/#69 at db526c9b2f863e120ddaa87f06573271c7d57288, before any access implementation. The author read the current common AST/checker, Reference and Issue contracts. No external model was invoked; exact deployed model/sampling settings are unavailable.

The chosen call expressions are desired translations of the adopted public names, not adopted detailed grammar or callable-signature rules. Existing by-value std gates supply separate explicit-owner controls. General declaration syntax, views, symbolic footprints and independent control-sector evidence remain unfinished. No QFT, deferred feature or maximum-sized example is involved.

Independent intended observations, specified before execution: H on zero gives 0/1 with probability 1/2. CNOT with H|0> control and |0> target gives 00/11 with probability 1/2, illustrating entanglement. With target H|1> = |->, CNOT changes the control |+> into |-> by phase kickback; final H on the control gives 10/11 with probability 1/2. Reusing the same owner as control and target must reject. These distributions are bounded checks, not all-input or arbitrary-reference proofs. Grammar rejection does not establish an alias rule.

Preserve first sources and actual outputs. Both current public source checking paths will be observed, with fixed CLI identity before/after. No native acceptance result is reused.
